usedFor: Infinity holds items and TRIGGERcmd runs commands on your computers, so “New Item” can run “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Item” in Infinity, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new item starts a command on your own computer, so board activity can kick off local work.

watchOut: “New Item” in Infinity is polling, so “Trigger Command” starts after a scheduled check.
